channel.title: Nicotine Science and Policy
channel.description: Daily digest of views, debates and discussions on nicotine science, policy, regulation and advocacy.

item.title: Sweden's political deadlock leaves EU nicotine tax plans in limbo
item.description: Sweden’s political deadlock is now affecting the future of nicotine taxation across the EU. The October vote on the revised Tobacco Excise Directive has been postponed until November, while uncertainty over Sweden’s next government raises questions about whether an agreement can be reached. (Published on October 16, 2026bysnusforumet.se)

item.title: Strict Rules Keep Smokers Smoking
item.description: Daily smoking rates in Kazakhstan remain at 15%, compared with just 5.3% in Sweden, highlighting a significant difference in tobacco control outcomes. Kazakhstan has banned vapes and nicotine pouches, while Sweden has combined conventional tobacco control measures with access to regulated smoke-free alternatives. (Published on October 16, 2026byplanetofthevapes.co.uk)

item.title: Counterpoint: A New Generation of the Same Old Mistake
item.description: Generational nicotine bans are gaining attention despite declining youth smoking and vaping rates in the United States. Critics argue that extending restrictions into adulthood could encourage illicit trade, limit consumer choice and undermine access to lower-risk nicotine products. (Published on October 16, 2026bydcjournal.com)
